title: bug: daemon repairPolicy.test.ts H1-H3 fail since CQ-R14d3 moved the check session onto the SSH route
description:
Found by QA (qa-c5835a34) on 2026-11-01 while re-running a full daemon gate at HEAD 67453739 for another row.

Symptom: packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/repairPolicy.test.ts, "decideRepair over real host check sessions", rows H1, H2 and H3 fail. The full suite gives 222 files: 3 failed, 6698 passed, 20 skipped (git-archive snapshot, env -i, Node 24.21.0, npm ci, tsc --noEmit clean, npm test). H1 expects outcome code-failure with exitCode 82, but gets infra-failure with exitCode null.

Cause: 6ac51c42 (CQ-R14d3, task-08062ce85dc94dcd80c62053e30f561f, DONE) changed runCheckSession in scripts/local-runner/check-session.mjs to open its stream through openGuestStream (guest-stream.mjs).
- openGuestStream first reads the guest address through provider.run, which defaults to execFile of a REAL `multipass info <name> --format json`. It also needs ssh and keyDir.
- R14d3 updated scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs (CHECK_ROUTE: a fake run via infoOf, plus string ssh and keyDir).
- It did not update this daemon test, which imports check-session.mjs directly. The test's exitingProvider(code) supplies only spawn, so the address read fails and every H session settles infra-failure.

Proof, an A/B in one snapshot: repairPolicy.test.ts passes 46/46 with check-session.mjs from 41680ea5 (before R14d3) and fails 3 of 46 with HEAD's.

Impact:
- Every full daemon-suite gate at HEAD shows these 3 failures: workers' and QA's snapshot gates, and CI's daemon test:coverage job.
- On a host with multipass on PATH, the H rows would exec a real `multipass info`.

Expected fix (the architect confirms): test-side. Give the H rows' fake provider the SSH-route shape the scripts test uses: a fake run that answers only `info <owned name> --format json` with an ipv4 address, plus ssh and keyDir strings. Allow for the spawn now following an async info read; see the R14d3 section of the gotcha-local-runner-tests memory. The runtime check-session.mjs looks intended and stays unchanged unless the architect finds a runtime defect.
definitionOfDone: repairPolicy.test.ts H1-H3 pass again against scripts/local-runner/check-session.mjs as landed in 6ac51c42, and every existing H1-H3 expectation is kept: none is weakened or deleted.
The H rows' fake provider never runs a real multipass or ssh binary: its run answers the info read, and ssh and keyDir are strings only.
The full daemon vitest suite passes in a git-archive snapshot (env -i, Node 24, npm ci, tsc --noEmit, npm test), and the completion cites the counts.
taskRails: Fix the test fixture in packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/repairPolicy.test.ts. Change scripts/local-runner/check-session.mjs only if the plan names a runtime defect.

implementationPlan.description:
Test-fixture fix in packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/repairPolicy.test.ts. check-session.mjs stays unchanged: R14d3's runtime is intended, and no runtime defect is named.
(a) exitingProvider(code, name) keeps its child script byte for byte and gains the SSH-route shape of scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs CHECK_ROUTE (lines ~1176-1186):
  - `run`: a fake that answers ONLY args deep-equal to ['info', name, '--format', 'json'], with stdout JSON.stringify({ errors: [], info: { [name]: INFO } }) and stderr ''. Copy INFO verbatim from that file, ipv4 ['10.0.0.2'] included, since readGuestInfo is proven to accept it. Any other call throws 'unexpected provider call'.
  - `ssh: path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'moe-stream', 'ssh')` and `keyDir: path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'moe-stream', 'keys')`: strings only, never created, and never executed because spawn is faked.
  - `spawn(command, argv, options)`: records command and returns the child.
  The provider records its run args and spawn commands in arrays the helper returns.
(b) settle(code) passes its owned name to exitingProvider. After runCheckSession settles, it asserts that the run calls are exactly [['info', name, '--format', 'json']] and the spawn commands exactly [the fake ssh string]. That proves no real multipass or ssh ran and the SSH route was taken. It returns the Settled result unchanged.
(c) The H1, H2 and H3 bodies stay byte-identical: no expectation is weakened, deleted or reworded. Only the fixture above them changes, plus a comment naming CQ-R14d3 (6ac51c42) and the scripts test's CHECK_ROUTE.
Ordering note (mem:gotcha-local-runner-tests, R14d3 section): the spawn now follows an async info read. The fake child emits only from its stdin write callback, never synchronously after the call, so it attaches no listener late. Keep it that way.
error handling: an unexpected provider call throws inside the fake, so the session settles infra-failure and H1's code-failure expectation fails loudly instead of passing vacuously. This is a test-only change.
implementationPlan.note: Fixture-only change; H1-H3 bodies untouched. 22 pre-existing dirty paths belong to others.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: A runtime fallback in check-session.mjs (a spawn without the info read) was rejected. The route change is intended and the task rail confines the fix to the fixture.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- openGuestStream reads the address through provider.run, which defaults to a real `multipass info`, before it spawns ssh.
- Daemon tests import scripts/local-runner modules through relative URLs, so the snapshot needs the whole tree.

- H3 deep-equals two settles: both must use the same deterministic name and fake shape, or the results diverge.
- The full suite takes minutes. Run it once, at the end.
